title: GTA 6 Wildlife Ecosystem: Rockstar Confirms Over 170 Animal Species
description: Recent reports from GameRant reveal that Rockstar has officially confirmed over 170 animal species will be featured in GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Wildlife Ecosystem: Rockstar Confirms Over 170 Animal Species

When it comes to building immersive open-world environments, Rockstar Games has consistently pushed the boundaries of the industry. Recently, according to a report from gaming outlet GameRant, Rockstar officially confirmed how Grand Theft Auto 6 is approaching its wildlife ecosystem, revealing that the game will feature over 170 different animal species.

### Expanding the Scope of Virtual Ecosystems

Following the industry-defining dynamic ecosystems seen in Red Dead Redemption 2, fans have eagerly anticipated how Rockstar would adapt and scale this technology for the modern setting of Leonida in GTA 6. The official confirmation of more than 170 animal species highlights the immense scale and attention to detail the development team is pouring into the game's natural environments.

While specific details on every single species are yet to be fully unpacked, this vast menagerie suggests that players can expect a deeply reactive and visually rich natural world. From the wetlands to the urban peripheries, the inclusion of such a high number of diverse species is set to elevate the realism and unpredictability of the open-world experience.

### Editor's Take

Rockstar's official confirmation of over 170 animal species in GTA 6 showcases their continued commitment to world-building depth. This massive variety in wildlife will undoubtedly make the game's environment feel remarkably alive, raising the bar once again for open-world immersion.
